purpose: Evidence receipt for the bounded visual and structural audit in docs/structural-reference-audit.md. This is not an owner likeness acceptance or engineering certification.

hydration.method: Read-only copy of the exact preserved primary-mirror binaries for the committed Git LFS pointers; each byte length and SHA-256 matched the pointer OID. No media was transformed. Hydration produced no Git content change.
hydration.gitStatusAfterRefresh: Hydrated pointer paths have no content change; unrelated worktree changes belong to concurrent production work.

comparisonCaptures.cameraNote: Before/after model images use the local structural study cameras; source illustration uses perspective. Direct visual comparison only, no normalized pixel ratio claimed.
comparisonCaptures.firsthandObservation: The current after captures include the left repair update visible at capture time. Compared with the earlier structural study, neck separation and layered construction read more clearly. Skull/cheek, bill profile, neck compactness and lower-body taper remain qualitative likeness gaps.

native.inspection: Opened read-only in Blender 5.2.1; 1,315 objects including 1,276 meshes and 39 empties/non-mesh objects; 63,468 evaluated triangles; no armature; six assigned material categories and seven unused legacy material datablocks; rigid named body/head/neck/wing/leg hierarchy.

editableProposal.status: structural proposal; owner likeness review pending; not a finished/accepted character model

limitations: Image comparisons are firsthand visual observations; perspective and occlusion make normalized pixel ratios unreliable, so none are asserted.
Story illustrations are not construction drawings, and story text is fictional canon rather than archaeological or engineering proof.
The silent controlled-motion clip supports only its exact approved story-page use.
Structural asset validation checks local file structure and named rigid hierarchy, not likeness, physical balance, production quality, owner acceptance, remote CI, or publication.
